notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating three 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger three times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating three 0/0 Wurm creature tokens and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurms enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurms dies, Faces of the Past triggers three times, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Wurmcalling for increasingly larger amounts to get infinite creature tokens.
